title: a Behavior Tree plus Blackboard driving an AIController on a pawn
proves: author the tree, the blackboard, the controller wiring and the pawn, then prove the wiring by reading it back

steps.label: primitive puerts_behavior_tree_build is registered
1. build the guard tree and its blackboard in one call
1. the blackboard carries all three keys, read back off the asset
primitive puerts_behavior_tree_inspect is registered
2. read the tree back with the independent inspector
2. all three composites are in the asset
2. all four tasks are in the asset
2. the tree names the blackboard the spec asked for
2. the inspector reports a structure hash
2. inspecting did not dirty the package
3. rerunning the identical spec converges
3. re-read after the rerun
3. the structure hash is unmoved by an identical rebuild
primitive puerts_blueprint_build is registered
4. author the AIController that runs the tree
4. the begin-and-run chain resolved to real pins
primitive puerts_graph_inspect is registered
5. prove the wiring by reading the BTAsset pin default back off the controller
5. a RunBehaviorTree node in the controller names BT_SliceGuard
5. a purpose-built read exists on paper
steps.detail: lane K's puerts_ai_controller_inspect reports RunBehaviorTree call sites and perception senses directly. It is not registered yet; graph_inspect covers the same claim today, so this slice does not block on it.

steps.label: 6. author the pawn the controller will possess
primitive puerts_class_defaults_patch is registered
7. point the pawn's class defaults at the authored controller
7. every class default read back as requested
7. did the transaction cover the CDO write
steps.detail: transaction_covers_cdo=undefined. Finding 0r: a class default object is not RF_Transactional, so Modify() can return false and editor undo does not take the write back. The command's own snapshot-and-restore boundary is the way back.

steps.label: primitive puerts_read_property is registered
8. read AIControllerClass back off the class default object
8. the pawn's class default really names the authored controller
9. rerunning the identical class defaults converges
9. the rerun wrote nothing and saved nothing
primitive puerts_scene_batch is registered
primitive puerts_nav_build is registered
10. watch the guard patrol
steps.detail: a Behavior Tree only ticks in a running game. PIE is reserved for the user to ask for, and the only runtime observation surface is the pie_agent_* family, which is legacy-only and also user-gated.
